title: Veteran Improvement Commercial Driver License Act of 2023
official_summary:
Veteran Improvement Commercial Driver License Act of 2023

This act authorizes approval of certain commercial driver education programs for purposes of Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) educational assistance if the programs meet specified requirements. Under current law, the VA may not approve enrollment of a veteran in courses for programs that do not lead to a standard degree that are offered at a new branch (i.e., a branch that has been operating for less than 2 years) of an educational institution.

Under the bill, a commercial driver education program offered at a new branch of an educational institution may be approved if it is appropriately licensed and uses the same curriculum as a commercial driver education program offered by the educational institution at another location that is already approved for purposes of VA educational assistance.

The educational institution must submit a report demonstrating the curriculum at the new branch is the same as the curriculum at the primary location in order to be exempt from the current prohibition against course approval at new branches.

summary.headline: Law lets veterans use VA education benefits at new branches of commercial truck-driving schools that meet certain conditions.
summary.what_it_does: Normally, the VA cannot approve veterans' education benefits for non-degree courses at a school branch that has been open less than 2 years. This law makes an exception for commercial driver education programs at new branches. The new branch must be properly licensed and use the same curriculum as an already VA-approved program at another location of the same school. The school must send a report showing the curriculum is the same.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and others using VA education benefits
who_it_affects.how: They can use their benefits for commercial driver training at newer school branches that meet the law's conditions.
Schools with an existing VA-approved program can get VA approval for new branches sooner by showing the new branch is licensed and uses the same curriculum.
The VA may approve these new-branch programs and must review the schools' curriculum reports.
